meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 做出有辨识度、不落俗套的界面设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想做出有辨识度、不显模板化的界面。
copy.tagline_en: Create distinctive, intentional UI with confident visual choices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a distinctive look beyond default templates.

howto.what: 在构建或改造界面时,Claude 会先做一份设计规划——命名色板、搭配字体、定布局概念和一个标志性元素,再对照需求检查是否落入模板化套路,最后按修订后的方案写代码。
howto.when: 当你提出新建界面,或要改造现有界面的视觉风格时,它会接管设计方向、排版与配色等决策。

say.text: 帮我给这个产品落地页做一版有辨识度的设计,别用默认套路
say.note: 会先给出设计规划再写代码

say.text: 这套 UI 的配色和字体太模板化了,重新定一套
say.note: 会重定色板、字体与布局方向

say.text: 用这个页面的真实内容重做视觉,加一个标志性元素
say.note: 先做规划并自审是否模板化

howto.what_en: When building or reshaping a UI, Claude first drafts a design plan — palette, typefaces, layout, one signature element — checks it against the brief for templated defaults, then writes code from the revised plan.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask for a new UI or a visual rework of an existing one, guiding aesthetic direction, typography and palette choices.

say_en.text: Design a distinctive landing page for this product, no default look
The palette and type on this UI feel templated — set a new direction
Rework the visuals using this page's real content, add a signature element
